cues.zh: 你觉得性别平等是个笑话？
cues.en: You think gender equality is a joke?

cues.zh: 不是，但这不是数学课吗？
cues.en: No, but isn't this a math class?

cues.zh: 好了，同学们，我相信你们都完成了研究作业。
cues.en: Now students, I trust you have all completed your research assignments.

cues.zh: 记住，得分最高的人将飞往纽约
cues.en: And remember the person with the highest mark will be flying to New York

cues.zh: 在世界数学峰会上发表论文。
cues.en: to present their paper at the World Mathematic Summit.

cues.zh: 小心！你盯着她看了十秒！
cues.en: Be careful! You've been staring at her for ten seconds!

cues.zh: 连续盯着女性看超过15秒属于骚扰！
cues.en: It is a form of harassment to stare at a woman for more than 15 seconds straight!

cues.zh: 我说“异性恋”的时候，并不是想冒犯性取向非传统的人。
cues.en: And when I use the term straight, I don't want to offend any persons of a non-traditional sexual preference.

cues.zh: 我说“非传统”的时候，也不是想冒犯那些反对……的人。
cues.en: And when I use the term "non-traditional", I don't mean to offend any persons who oppose...

cues.zh: 历来都被视为理所当然的……
很遗憾，Sunshine，你的研究作业只值十分之一。
cues.en: Unfortunately, Sunshine, your research assignment is only worth a 1/10.

cues.zh: 我在电子学数学方法课上用傅里叶变换分析
cues.en: I've used Fourier transform in mathematical methods in electronics to analyze

cues.zh: 高危患者的心电图，并计算他们心脏病发作的风险。
cues.en: the electro-diagrams of at risk patients and calculate their risk of experiencing a heart attack.

cues.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种新方法，但有望挽救成千上万人的生命。
cues.en: I mean, it's a new method but it could potentially save thousands of lives.

cues.zh: 在很多宗教里，红色被视为冒犯。
cues.en: Red is considered offensive in many religions.

cues.zh: 你为什么要把一切都贬低成单一的颜色……
cues.en: Why would you belittle everything down to a singular color...

cues.zh: ……当人性本是一道充满美与灵性的彩虹时？
cues.en: ...when humanity is a rainbow of beauty and spirituality?

cues.zh: 行吧，7分就7分！但这依然意味着我能去峰会了，对吧？
cues.en: OK, fine, 7/10! But that still means I get to go to the summit, right?
The marking process isn't over yet.

cues.zh: 现在，既然我们生活在一个崇尚平等的社会
cues.en: Now, because we live in a society based on equality

cues.zh: 总分理应在所有学生中平分。
cues.en: The total amount of marks ought to be divided equally among our students.
You've got to be kidding me!

cues.zh: 干得漂亮，同学们，我们人人平等了
cues.en: Well done, students, we're all equal
But then who gets to go to the summit?

cues.zh: 我们还没算特权积分呢！
cues.en: We haven't added our privilege points yet!

cues.zh: 来，Penelope，你是女性，所以加1点特权积分。
cues.en: Now, Penelope, you are female, so that's +1 privilege point.
However you are white, so that's -1.

cues.zh: 这样你的最终得分是6分。
cues.en: that leaves you with a total score of 6/10.

cues.zh: Simon，很遗憾，你是顺性别的直男白人……
cues.en: Simon, unfortunately you're straight, white and male

cues.zh: 是的，所以你要扣 4 点特权分，

cues.en: which leaves you with a total score of 1.

cues.zh: 你是男性，而且我不喜欢你，
cues.en: You're male and I don't like you,

cues.zh: 但你是棕色人种，而且性别表现模糊。
cues.en: But you are brown and sexually ambiguous.
That leaves you with a total score of 5.

cues.zh: 等等，我哪里性别表现模糊了？
cues.en: Wait, why am I sexually ambiguous?

cues.zh: 嗯……我是同性恋、跨性别者、亚裔，
cues.en: Hum... I'm gay, I'm trans, I'm asian

cues.zh: 我超重、阶层低、智力不高、长得不好看，
cues.en: I'm overweight, I'm lower class, I'm unintelligent, unattractive
I've got hairs on my nipples
And I also got body odor.

cues.zh: 我也不太会跑步，没法自己系鞋带。
cues.en: And I can't really run properly or tie my shoelaces by myself.

cues.zh: 我还曾经看着一只鸽子死去。
cues.en: And I once watched a pigeon die.

cues.zh: 总分就是 18 分，满分 10 分！
cues.en: That leaves you with a total score of 18/10!
Well done, Sunshine, you're going to New York!
We knew you could do it!

cues.zh: 他们刚在纸上写了“平等”，还画了爱心！
cues.en: They've just written "Equality" and drawn love hearts on a piece of paper!

cues.zh: 他表达了自己，而且表达得真美！
cues.en: He expressed himself and it's beautiful!
This has nothing to do with mathematics!

cues.zh: 你以为自己数学好、科学懂、事实也掌握得多了不起吗？
cues.en: You think you're so great with your maths and your science and your facts?
Yeah, feelings are more important than facts!

cues.zh: 别再用你们不同的观点侵犯我了！
cues.en: Stop violating me with your different opinion!

cues.zh: 我有权表达自己的想法！
cues.en: I have the right to speak my mind!
No, we have the right not to be offended!

cues.zh: 如果你们不停止言语攻击我们，
cues.en: And if you don't stop verbally assaulting us,

cues.zh: 我们就只能为了自卫而攻击你们！
cues.en: we will be forced to attack you in self-defense!

cues.zh: 事实上，我们完全有权这么做。
cues.en: Actually, we have every right to do so.
And it's illegal for you to fight back.

cues.zh: 受死吧，要知道社会正义赢了。受死！
cues.en: Prepare to die, and know that social justice won. Death!
